plugins.name: ai-look-up
plugins.description: Catches aimless AI grinding (repeated commands, failure loops, long runs with no output) and nudges the agent to stop and self-review mid-run. Also injects the real local time on a schedule, since agents are bad at judging how long they've been going. v0.7 adds an out-of-host review channel: the hook writes a request, and an independent watcher process (with its own API key) reviews asynchronously and sends back a verdict. The main agent never touches this path.

description_i18n.zh-CN: 盯住 AI 的空跑:重复的命令、连续失败、跑很久却没产出文件。命中就在运行中途提醒它停一下自查,并定期把真实本地时间注进去——AI 估不准自己花了多久。v0.7 加了第三通道:钩子只写一张请求单,宿主外面一个独立 watcher(用自己的 key)异步审查再回注结论,主代理全程碰不到这条链路。带 /lookup-review、/lookup-status、/lookup-config、/lookup-watch 四个命令。
